problem_text: For y = x^2 + 1, find y when x = 2.
student_prompt: Answer this short repair question. Keep your working brief.

error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If y is found as 3, the next link is treating x squared carefully and keeping the operation order. Table values for quadratic graphs need substitution plus order control.

hint_ladder.title: Table value
hint_ladder.prompt: A table value comes from substituting the given x into the formula for y.

hint_ladder.title: Square first
hint_ladder.prompt: For x = 2, calculate 2 squared first, then add 1.

hint_ladder.title: Operation order
hint_ladder.prompt: A common slip is doing 2 + 1 before squaring, or forgetting that x^2 means x times x.

hint_ladder.title: Table routine
hint_ladder.prompt: Substitute the x-value, follow powers before addition, and record the resulting y-value. Use this formula; do not copy.
